periods.summary: Kaieda attends the Daien strategy meeting as a prominent B-rank-or-higher knight, then remains in Kyushu after Kurono is ordered back to Tokyo. He tries to keep order among the refugees, promising protection despite public anger. When Toka proposes the power-grid strategy, Kaieda supports her rather than suppressing the plan, helps present it to Itsuki Kurogane, and coordinates the operational authorization. At Central Substation, he receives repair status from the electrical teams, confirms that all people have completed their work, and orders extreme operation when Toka is ready. He recognizes that Toka's capacity to accept others' entrusted power exceeds his own.
